hero.title: Working AI, demonstrated to the people who buy it.
hero.description: Four to six selected enterprise AI companies demonstrate working products to a room of senior buyers. Not a pitch competition — working software, verified outcomes, and pre-booked introductions.

format.title: A 45-Minute Dedicated Stage Slot
format.description: Each Showcase demonstration follows a rigorous three-part structure:

steps.title: 1. The Enterprise Problem (2 Mins)
steps.desc: The specific friction point, risk constraint, or operational bottleneck in the enterprise.

steps.title: 2. Live Product Demonstration (5 Mins)
steps.desc: Working software performing live execution in the production environment.

steps.title: 3. Measurable Outcome & ROI (2 Mins)
steps.desc: Audited results: cycle time compression, cost reduction, or risk mitigation evidence.

connections.title: 1-on-1 Enterprise Connections
connections.description: Beyond the stage demonstrations, AIX facilitates pre-scheduled 15-minute briefings during the afternoon break, connecting showcase founders directly with enterprise buyers who requested further interrogation.

criteria.title: Enterprise Grade
criteria.desc: Demonstrable SOC2/ISO compliance or pathway. Built for institutional data.

criteria.title: Live Software Only
criteria.desc: No slide decks on stage. Demos must be live, working software.

criteria.title: Verifiable ROI
criteria.desc: Clear metrics on how the application improves margins, security, or capability.
